svg.title: Frustum-invariant dolly-zoom / 视锥半高守恒推拉变焦

g.text: VISUAL LAB / ROUND 19 / FRUSTUM HALF-WIDTH INVARIANT · ZERO SUBJECT DRIFT · NO DIFFUSION CLAIM
Lock the frustum width; keep the subject size still. / 锁死视锥半高，推拉变焦主体不漂移。
57 solids · 13/13 checks · locked subject 40.01% (0% drift) vs linear FOV drift 22.21%
8192 CPU dolly-zoom queries: direct cotangent 0.49 ms / 32-step FOV bisection 9.08 ms
锁死视锥半高 W*=1.9996 u 并按 θ(α)=2·atan(W*/d(α)) 耦合反解，消除线性视场角插值在 α=0.5 处的 22.21% 主体缩水。
